title: Fujimori vote tally shifts again as Peru runoff count remains uncertain
detail: Keiko Fujimori's vote tally shifted again in the ongoing Peru presidential runoff count, keeping the result uncertain as vote tabulation continues. The volatile tallying reflects the extremely tight race between Fujimori and leftist Roberto Sánchez following the June 7 second round. Live count swings have become a hallmark of Peruvian election nights, echoing the nail-biting 2021 runoff between Fujimori and Pedro Castillo.
